method: Batch 47 (horses2). Unchanged EntityHorse (wi) with a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe) riding it, driven through the real EntityAIRunAroundLikeCrazy, EntityLiving.onUpdate and the rider update. Records: ride-* (the 1 in 50 buck, temper, the tame roll, the angry rear, the dismount, riding again and use), sound-* (gait, eat and angry sound draws), undead-* (skeleton and zombie horses, wild and tame), idle-* and foal-wall/corner (a foal grows beside a wall: the setSize moveEntity nudge with collisions). Per tick: mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks. See EndermanWolfProbe.java run47h.
